"""Commit the exact K299 overlay after bound gate4 and owned continuous-security evidence."""
import hashlib,json,runpy,signal
from pathlib import Path
R=Path('/private/tmp/zee-p19-k298/k299-validation')
E=Path('/Users/mustafaerbay/.codex/zee-evidence/2026-10-14-urunlesme')
T=Path('/private/tmp/zee-p19-k298')
S='90fe778e86b9de28046f0f7bd77b47df138a2212'
TREE='3bb1340d68a1073bb9cbda71ce943c222959db24'
HELPER_SHA='e76fe65b6103fc4732aafc4468afc5bbf3d0699a0f79d7f74879165636ebb1a9'
GATE_DRIVER=T/'k299-gates-v5.py'
GATE_DRIVER_SHA='7bfc896c9f6fcc01cb902079019c760ce7c1f8b45ff081c8842c00579b4f1cf7'
SECURITY_DRIVER=T/'k299-security-v2.py'
SECURITY_DRIVER_SHA='4d551c9a4a86be9483dfac3dceaf9285d7677b9ce00ebb64405c525c78744b1e'
STOP=False;H=None

def cancel(*_):
    global STOP
    STOP=True
    if H is not None:H['run'].__globals__['CANCELLED']=True
for n in (signal.SIGTERM,signal.SIGINT):signal.signal(n,cancel)
helper=R/'scripts/lifecycle_core.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==HELPER_SHA
H=runpy.run_path(str(helper));assert not STOP
assert H['digest'](GATE_DRIVER)==GATE_DRIVER_SHA and H['digest'](SECURITY_DRIVER)==SECURITY_DRIVER_SHA
out=E/'p19-k299-source-commit-2.json'
assert not out.exists() and not out.is_symlink()
gate_path=E/'p19-k299-gates-4/PROOF.json'
controller_path=E/'p19-k299-gates-4-controller.json'
security_path=E/'p19-k299-security-2/PROOF.json'
security_controller_path=E/'p19-k299-security-2-controller.json'
security_log_path=security_path.parent/'security.log'
gate_outer_log=E/'p19-k299-gates-4-controller.log'
security_outer_log=E/'p19-k299-security-2-controller.log'
for path in (gate_path,controller_path,security_path,security_controller_path):
    assert path.resolve(strict=True)==path and path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink() and 0<path.stat().st_size<=4*1024**2
input_paths=[gate_path,controller_path,security_path,security_controller_path,GATE_DRIVER,SECURITY_DRIVER,helper,gate_outer_log,security_outer_log,security_log_path]
input_hashes={str(path):H['digest'](path) for path in input_paths}
gate=json.loads(gate_path.read_bytes());controller=json.loads(controller_path.read_bytes())
security=json.loads(security_path.read_bytes());security_controller=json.loads(security_controller_path.read_bytes())
ENV={'RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN':'1.93.1','CARGO_BUILD_JOBS':'1','RUST_TEST_THREADS':'1','CARGO_NET_OFFLINE':'true','CARGO_TARGET_DIR':None}
PINNED=['scripts/tests/pdf-plugin-native.py','scripts/tests/service-fault-native.py','scripts/tests/pdf-plugin-test.py','scripts/tests/service-fault-test.py','compiler/tests/pdf_plugin_testi.rs','compiler/tests/service_fault_testi.rs','scripts/lifecycle_core.py','compiler/Cargo.toml','compiler/Cargo.lock','compiler/build.rs','compiler/rust-toolchain.toml']
NAMES=['fmt','counts','summary','phase-matrix','clippy','function-trend','spec-drift','catalog-freshness','conformance-guard','semantic-regresyon-guard','core-freeze-guard','diff-check','secret-scan']
expected_gate_argv=['python3','-I','-B',str(GATE_DRIVER),'--repo',str(R),'--out',str(gate_path.parent),'--target',str(R/'compiler/target'),'--mode','all']
expected_security_argv=['python3','-I','-B',str(SECURITY_DRIVER),'--repo',str(R),'--source-sha',S,'--source-tree',TREE,'--gate-proof',str(gate_path),'--gate-controller',str(controller_path),'--gate-driver',str(GATE_DRIVER),'--out',str(security_path.parent)]
assert controller['argv']==expected_gate_argv
assert security_controller['argv']==expected_security_argv
for receipt in (controller,security_controller):
    assert receipt['status']=='passed' and type(receipt['exit']) is int and receipt['exit']==0
    assert type(receipt['observed_exit']) is int and receipt['observed_exit']==0
    assert receipt['owned_group_closed_and_reaped'] is True and 'cancellation_reason' not in receipt
assert gate['schema']=='zee-k299-owned-gates-1' and gate['status']=='passed'
assert gate['source_parent']==S and gate['source_tree']==TREE and gate['mode']=='all'
assert gate['repo']==str(R) and gate['target']==str(R/'compiler/target') and gate['environment']==ENV
assert all(gate[k] is True for k in ['source_pins_unchanged','source_parent_unchanged','driver_unchanged'])
assert gate['driver_sha256']==GATE_DRIVER_SHA
assert [c['name'] for c in gate['commands']]==NAMES
assert all(c['status']=='passed' and c['reaped'] is True and type(c['exit']) is int and type(c['observed_exit']) is int and c['exit']==c['observed_exit']==0 for c in gate['commands'])
assert set(gate['source_pins'])==set(PINNED)
assert {n:H['digest'](R/n) for n in PINNED}==gate['source_pins']
assert security['schema']=='zee-k299-owned-security-1' and security['status']=='passed'
assert security['repo']==str(R) and security['source_parent']==S and security['source_tree']==TREE
assert security['environment']==ENV and security['driver_sha256']==SECURITY_DRIVER_SHA and security['helper_sha256']==HELPER_SHA
assert security['gate_proof']==str(gate_path) and security['gate_controller']==str(controller_path)
assert security['gate_proof_sha256']==input_hashes[str(gate_path)] and security['gate_controller_sha256']==input_hashes[str(controller_path)]
assert all(security[k] is True for k in ['source_pins_unchanged','source_overlay_unchanged','inputs_unchanged'])
assert security['target_command_count']==1 and not security.get('cancelled',False)
command=security['command']
assert command['name']=='security-continuous' and command['argv']==['bash','scripts/guvenlik-kapisi.sh','--surekli'] and command['cwd']==str(R)
assert command['status']=='passed' and type(command['exit']) is int and type(command['observed_exit']) is int and command['exit']==command['observed_exit']==0
assert command['owned_group_closed_and_reaped'] is True
assert command['log_path']==str(security_log_path) and command['log_sha256']==input_hashes[str(security_log_path)]
assert command['log_bytes']==security_log_path.stat().st_size<24*1024**2
assert security['input_sha256_start']==security['input_sha256_end']
security_inputs=security['input_sha256_start']
expected_security_inputs={str(path) for path in [gate_path,controller_path,GATE_DRIVER,SECURITY_DRIVER,helper,R/'scripts/guvenlik-kapisi.sh']}
expected_security_inputs.update(str(gate_path.parent/(c['name']+'.log')) for c in gate['commands'])
assert set(security_inputs)==expected_security_inputs
assert {path:H['digest'](Path(path)) for path in security_inputs}==security_inputs
expected_snapshot={'source_parent':S,'source_tree':TREE,'source_pins':gate['source_pins'],'end_overlay':gate['end_overlay'],'end_diff_sha256':gate['end_diff_sha256']}
assert security['source_begin']==security['source_end']==expected_snapshot
assert H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD')==S and H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')==TREE and H['git'](R,'branch','--show-current')=='codex/k299-cancellation'
assert H['git'](R,'diff','--cached','--name-only')==''
paths=gate['end_overlay'];assert paths and not any(n.startswith('compiler/src/') for n in paths)
changed=H['run'](['git','-C',R,'diff','--name-only','-z','HEAD']).split(b'\0')+H['run'](['git','-C',R,'ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard','-z']).split(b'\0')
assert set(paths)=={n.decode() for n in changed if n}
assert {n:H['digest'](R/n) for n in paths}==paths
assert hashlib.sha256(H['run'](['git','-C',R,'diff','--binary','HEAD'])).hexdigest()==gate['end_diff_sha256']
for c in gate['commands']:
    log=gate_path.parent/(c['name']+'.log')
    assert H['digest'](log)==c['log_sha256']
    input_hashes[str(log)]=c['log_sha256']
H['git'](R,'diff','--check')
assert not STOP and {path:H['digest'](Path(path)) for path in input_hashes}==input_hashes
H['git'](R,'add','--',*sorted(paths))
assert set(H['git'](R,'diff','--cached','--name-only').splitlines())==set(paths)
assert H['git'](R,'diff','--name-only')==''
assert {n:H['digest'](R/n) for n in paths}==paths
assert not STOP and {path:H['digest'](Path(path)) for path in input_hashes}==input_hashes
H['git'](R,'commit','-m','fix(test): worker kabulü için depo kökünü kanonikleştir (K-299)')
source=H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD');H['clean_exact'](R,source)
assert H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD^')==S and {n:H['digest'](R/n) for n in paths}==paths
assert {path:H['digest'](Path(path)) for path in input_hashes}==input_hashes
receipt={'status':'committed','source_commit':source,'source_tree':H['git'](R,'rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),'parent':S,'paths':paths,'driver_sha256':H['digest'](Path(__file__)),'gate_proof_sha256':input_hashes[str(gate_path)],'gate_controller_sha256':input_hashes[str(controller_path)],'security_proof_sha256':input_hashes[str(security_path)],'security_controller_sha256':input_hashes[str(security_controller_path)],'security_log_sha256':input_hashes[str(security_log_path)],'input_sha256':input_hashes,'compiler_source_changed':False,'native_acceptance':'pending-on-this-exact-clean-source'}
with out.open('x') as stream:stream.write(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'status':receipt['status'],'source':source,'tree':receipt['source_tree']}))
